payload.core_mechanism_summary: Double loop over block indices (even for '(', odd for ')') maintaining running balance and min balance; for each pair compute valid subsegment count via min/max without per-character enumeration.
payload.rationale: Algorithm enumerates all start/end block pairs efficiently (O(n²) on blocks) and uses closed-form counting per pair. The bounding via min/max to compute counts resembles branch-and-bound's bounding concept, making it the best fit among given complete_search subtypes.
